summary_narrative: This CV belongs to a Mid-level SWE with approximately 3 years of experience, currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree while working as a Blockchain Engineer at Blockscout. The CV demonstrates strong progression from early backend roles through SRE to blockchain engineering with increasing ownership. Key strengths include clear achievement-oriented language, good technical breadth, and professional presentation. The primary weakness is insufficient quantification, particularly in the current role which carries the most weight for job applications. With targeted additions of metrics (transaction volumes, latency improvements, team sizes, and delivery timelines), this CV could move from Adequate (62/100) to Strong (70+) territory. The writing quality and structure are solid; the main opportunity is converting good qualitative achievements into verifiable quantitative ones.
